'''Benoni Ulte''' was an [[Ibhaan'I]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]], or ''[[Bronwen]]'', who lived apart from his tribe as tradition dictated. Settling in [[Vakeyya]] to learn more about his [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] ancestors, Ulte visited new arrivals to [[Soco-Jarel Spaceport]]. Ulte became the caretaker of the painting "[[Tejha Larel]]," which depicted the [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Cjaalysce]]. The painting had been discovered by [[Pret Swain]]'s fatherin the ruins of [[Cjaalysce'I]]. The painting was accompanied by the shadow of the spirit of the late [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Iann Doaba]], Cjaalysce's lover, haunting the painting.<ref name="BSS" />
